I have everything. The four dispatch functions live in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, all converging on the same delivery path.

q30.
memos.memo.created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memos.memo.updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memos.memo.deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memos.memo.comment.created (comment lifecycle event): DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook

Convergence for delivery: All three of the created/updated/deleted dispatchers delegate to the private `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (passing their respective activity-type string) in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`. Both that helper (line 71) and `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 43) then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` — defined at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, which enqueues onto `asyncPostQueue` and ultimately calls `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`) for the actual HTTP delivery.

Note on the comment event: it's dispatched from the comment flow (`memo_service_comments.go:119`) and does not route through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — it builds and posts its payload directly — but it still lands on the shared `webhook.PostAsync`/`Post` delivery path. If you consider only the three core memo lifecycle events (create/update/delete), the single convergence point is `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` → `webhook.PostAsync`.
